rationale: Executive Order 13170 is a standing set of directions to agencies with no end date or condition in its own text, and nothing held revokes, supersedes or amends it: the only Office of the Federal Register note is the cross-reference 'See: EO 11625' (an earlier order that it cites as authority), the U.S. Code edition current through 2026-10-09 still prints its full text as a note to 15 U.S.C. 644 with no ending statement, and no held order cites its number or exact title. The two 90-day due dates in the order are not ends. It was therefore operative on 2026-10-14, on the original-plus-bounded-search route.
